metadata.title: May 15, 2015 - Zounds!
metadata.author: by Nancy Cole Stuart / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: It began as the Haloid Company
Pepper variety named for French Guiana's capital
Stuff on boards used with nails
Pod occupants that display great proficiency?
Reddish-brown horses that place in races?
Civil War song from which "Love Me Tender" was adapted
Performing troupe in a very expensive circus?
Dramatic works of a vulgar nature?
Name shared by a dozen popes
Reactor parts where particles crash into each other?
He wrote some of his best paragraphs on Friday
Peter Lorre's role in "The Story of Mankind"
